messages:
alan_support: Greenline POC experiencing repeated 5xx (503 + occasional 502) during scripted load test at ~250 rps. Started ~15:17 UTC. Demo window in 30m, customer anxious.

emma_sales: FYI they asked about SLA and whether Private would avoid this. Theyprefer Hosted for speed but will consider Dedicated if reliability is flaky.

nina_reliability: Can you share example headers and any X-Request-Id? Also whether they're using streaming?

alan_support: Streaming yes, request id examples: `r_77a9`, `r_77b0`. Sample response: `HTTP/1.1 503` 
`{"code":"capacity_throttled","message":"no_available_slot"}`

tomas_prod: Looks like slot exhaustion + queue buildup. Console shows agent restart spikes and image pull warmups when scale events happen. Autoscale target lagging ~40s.

nina_reliability: Two immediate actions: 1) enable short-lived burstpool increase for Greenline, 2) set a graceful degrade route to `gptx-7b-v1-quant` for non-critical demo endpoints to reduce memory.

alan_support: Can we also temporarily lower `batching.max_tokens` and `batching.max_concurrent` for their route to avoid oversized micro-batches?

tomas_prod: Yes. Proposed quick patch applied: `batching.max_tokens=512`, `batching.max_concurrent=32`, `routing.fallback_percent=20`, `min_replicas=2` for the POC.

ops-bot: deploy event: applying config patch to account `greenline-poc-9` at 2026-04-02T15:23:12Z

emma_sales: Quick customer note: will fallback affect cost for them? They asked about billing during POC.

alan_support: Billing is per-model. If requests hit 7b fallback, cost will follow 7b pricing. We can offer a demo credit; I proposed 2% credit to cover fallback.

nina_reliability: Monitoring shows queue depth drop from 110->20 and inflight from 70->28 within 1 minute of changes. No 5xx seen in last 8m.

alan_support: Great. Customer resumed demo. They reported lower error rate but requested a deeper postmortem and log bundle for compliance.

tomas_prod: Uploaded support bundle: s3://support-bundles/greenline/1899901234-debug.tar.gz (includes kernel OOM logs, autoscale timeline, request traces `r_77a9`,`r_77b0`).

nina_reliability: Action items: (1) schedule follow-up to discuss Dedicated/DPO options if they need strict SLOs, (2) run a replay with same ramp and longer pre-warm to quantify warmup tail, (3) rollback burst override in 30m if stable.

emma_sales: I'll loop in exec sponsor and finance for POC credit and Dedicated pricing if they push.

alan_support: Marking thread monitoring. If errors reappear I'll escalate to oncall. Thanks all :thumbsup:

ops-bot: autoscale event: added worker `gpu-node-213` for greenline-poc-9 at 2026-04-02T15:29:44Z
